items.title: 5 day forecast updated as of 13 November 2026 5:30pm
items.description:
##Today##

Dry, with clear intervals this evening and early tonight. Light to moderate west or southwest winds, and temperatures falling to 2 or 3°C.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 2°C and max. air temperature 9°C


##Rainfall (mm):##

0


##Wind Speed##

12


##Wind Direction##

W


##Wind##

##Visibility##

Good.


##Comments##

##Tomorrow##

Becoming cloudier soon after midnight with a few showers before dawn, and a minimum temperature of 2 or 3°C. Variable cloud and occasional showers for the remainder of the day. Light to moderate southwest winds, gradually increasing fresh to strong. Maximum temperature of 11°C. Comments: Strong winds developing.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 3°C and max. air temperature 11°C


##Rainfall (mm):##

1-5


##Wind Speed##

22


##Wind Direction##

SW


##Wind##

Southwest 10-15, gradually increasing south or southwest 20-25, occasionally 30 later.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate in showers.


##Comments##

Nil.


##Sunday, 15 November 2026##

A band of rain will arrive around midnight, with spells of rain continuing through the morning and turning heavy at times. This will gradually peter out through the afternoon, leaving some clear intervals and only isolated showers. Fresh to strong, mainly southwest winds will decrease for a time in the morning before veering north or northwest. Winds will strengthen further later in the day and into the evening again, bringing a risk of gales for a time. Maximum temperature 10°C.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 5°C and max. air temperature 10°C


##Rainfall (mm):##

10-20


##Wind Speed##

22


##Wind Direction##

W


##Wind##

South or southwest 20-25, occasionally 30 at first, veering west or southwest 15-20 later in the morning, veering north or northwest 20-32 later in the afternoon or evening, perhaps increasing 35-40 with gusts 45-50 later.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate or poor in rain. Occasional hill fog.


##Comments##

Strong winds. Risk of heavy rain. Risk of gales later.


##Monday, 16 November 2026##

Some clear intervals and showers overnight. Minimum temperature of 1°C. Mainly dry with bright or sunny spells during the daytime, then cloud thickens early in the night with a band of rain soon arriving. Fresh northwest winds, becoming light and variable for a time during the day, before increasing strong east later. Top temperature of 8°C.


##Temperature##

##Wind Speed##

##Wind##

North or northwest 20-32, perhaps 35-40 with gusts 45-50 at first, backing west or northwest 20-25 through the morning, decreasing 5-15 later.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate in showers.


##Comments##

Strong winds later. Risk of frost and ice.


##Tuesday, 17 November 2026##

Cloudy with an area of rain arriving around midnight and continuing for much of the day. Fresh to strong east winds. Top temperature 8°C.
